items.title: 阿曼Al Yazan海滨综合开发项目公布约2亿里亚尔投资计划
items.title_en: Oman's Al Yazan waterfront development in Muttrah unveils RO200 million investment plan
items.sector: 滨水房地产及旅游开发
items.summary: OMRAN Group与VA Group于11月9日公布Muttrah的Al Yazan滨水综合项目，拟投资约2亿阿曼里亚尔，在Port Sultan Qaboos区域分期开发约1500套住宅及商业、休闲配套。项目占地18.5公顷，首期准备工程预计于2026年底启动。拟投资额不是已授予建筑合同金额。
items.summary_en: On 9 November, OMRAN Group and VA Group unveiled Al Yazan, a proposed RO200 million waterfront development in Muttrah as part of the Port Sultan Qaboos redevelopment. The 18.5-hectare project envisages about 1,500 homes alongside retail and leisure uses, with first-phase enabling works expected before the end of 2026. The investment plan is not an awarded construction contract.
items.why_it_matters: 滨海开发项目有明确规模及准备工程时间，为酒店、地产及配套供应提供潜在线索。
items.why_it_matters_en: A defined waterfront development with a planned enabling-works timetable may offer hospitality, real-estate and supply-chain opportunities.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注住宅建筑、酒店与商业精装修、机电、建材及家具供应。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track residential construction, hospitality and retail fit-out, MEP, building materials and furniture supply.
items.stage: 开发计划公布／准备工程待启动

items.title: 阿曼杜库姆签署543万里亚尔金枪鱼与鱿鱼加工厂投资协议
items.title_en: Oman's Duqm signs RO5.43 million tuna and squid processing investment agreement
items.summary: 阿曼农业、渔业和水资源部与Al Sawari International于11月9日签署约543万阿曼里亚尔投资协议，在杜库姆渔业工业区建设金枪鱼及鱿鱼加工包装工厂，包括专门的鱿鱼加工生产线。未公布独立工程总包授标。
items.summary_en: On 9 November, Oman's Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources signed an investment agreement worth approximately RO5.43 million with Al Sawari International for a tuna and squid processing and packaging facility in Duqm's fisheries industries zone, including a dedicated squid processing line. No separate main construction contract was announced.
items.why_it_matters: 已有具体投资主体与工厂建设内容，适合设备和工业设施供应链跟进。
items.why_it_matters_en: The signed investment agreement identifies a developer and facility scope, presenting potential equipment and industrial supply opportunities.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注食品处理设备、冷链、包装生产线、厂房与仓储服务。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor food-processing machinery, cold-chain systems, packaging lines, factory construction and storage services.

items.title: 阿曼Khazaen经济城拟建45MW人工智能数据中心园区
items.title_en: Oman's Khazaen Economic City plans 45MW AI data centre campus
items.sector: AI数据中心及数字基础设施
items.summary: 11月9日消息，Khazaen Economic City拟开发Khazaen Data Campus，占地约5.5万平方米，初期规划45MW计算及数据中心容量，并预留扩展至100MW的可能。项目正在设计阶段，目标2028年启动初步运营；工程预算与EPC合同尚未披露。该项目与塞拉莱AI园区不同。
items.summary_en: A 9 November report describes the proposed Khazaen Data Campus at Khazaen Economic City, covering approximately 55,000 square metres with an initial 45MW data-centre capacity and potential expansion to 100MW. The development is in the design phase with initial operation targeted for 2028; construction budget and EPC award have not been disclosed. It is separate from the Salalah AI campuses.
items.why_it_matters: 数据中心设计阶段可能产生未来电力、冷却、机电和施工需求，但并非公开招标。
items.why_it_matters_en: The design-stage campus may generate later power, cooling, MEP and construction needs, but is not an open tender.
items.gci_opportunity: 跟进配电、备用电源、冷却系统、数据中心建设及客户服务。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track power distribution, backup generation, cooling systems, data-centre construction and services.

items.title: 迪拜南城Iron Mountain启用3.7万平方米物流设施
items.title_en: Dubai South opens Iron Mountain's 37,000-square-metre UAE logistics facility
items.summary: 迪拜南城11月9日宣布Iron Mountain位于EZDubai Logistics Hub的3.7万平方米仓储物流中心启用，统一为Unilever提供仓储和订单履约服务，并采用无人机盘点、机器人库存计数及自动化技术。该设施已投入运营，不是新建工程招标。
items.summary_en: On 9 November, Dubai South announced the opening of Iron Mountain's 37,000-square-metre facility in EZDubai Logistics Hub. It consolidates Unilever warehousing and fulfilment, with drone-enabled inventory operations, robotic counts and other automation. The facility is operational rather than a new construction tender.
items.why_it_matters: 设施投运表明物流及自动化服务需求，但新的施工机会有限。
items.why_it_matters_en: Opening the facility demonstrates logistics and automation demand, while opportunities for new construction are limited.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注仓储自动化、物流分包、包装及订单履约服务合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor warehousing automation, logistics subcontracting, co-packing and fulfilment-service partnerships.

items.title: 迪拜Anabtawi启用1.5亿迪拉姆食品制造工厂
items.title_en: Dubai Anabtawi opens AED150 million food manufacturing facility
items.summary: Anabtawi Food Industries于11月9日在Dubai Industrial City启用投资约1.5亿迪拉姆的冰淇淋制造设施，占地超过17.2万平方英尺，年产能超过4500万升，服务阿联酋、海湾及中东北非市场，并提供自有品牌生产与代工包装。已建成投产而非新施工招标。
items.summary_en: On 9 November, Anabtawi Food Industries inaugurated an AED150 million ice-cream manufacturing facility at Dubai Industrial City. The plant exceeds 172,000 square feet with annual capacity above 45 million litres, serving UAE, GCC and MENA markets with branded and private-label production and co-packing. The plant is operational, not a new construction tender.
items.why_it_matters: 生产投运带来包装、分销、食品原料及贸易合作潜力。
items.why_it_matters_en: The operating factory may offer packaging, distribution, ingredients and trade partnerships.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注食品原辅材料、包装、代工、渠道与跨境分销。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor food ingredients, packaging, private-label manufacturing, distribution and cross-border trade.

items.title: 埃及与Cheiron签署东亚历山大近海逾4200万美元天然气勘探协议
items.title_en: Egypt EGAS signs more than USD42 million East Alexandria offshore gas exploration agreement with Cheiron
items.summary: 埃及天然气控股公司EGAS与Cheiron于11月9日签署地中海东亚历山大近海天然气勘探协议，最低投资超过4200万美元，涉及钻探3口勘探井及地震数据重新处理。该范围为上游勘探工作，不是已授生产设施EPC合同。
items.summary_en: On 9 November, Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Company EGAS signed an East Alexandria offshore gas exploration agreement with Cheiron, committing a minimum investment of more than USD42 million for drilling three exploration wells and reprocessing seismic data. This is upstream exploration work, not an awarded production-facility EPC contract.
items.why_it_matters: 协议具有明确勘探任务与最低投资，未来可产生专业海工及技术服务需求。
items.why_it_matters_en: The defined drilling scope and minimum investment may generate specialised upstream and offshore service demand.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注海上钻井设备、地球物理服务、技术及海工物流。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track offshore drilling equipment, geophysical services, technical support and marine logistics.

items.title: 莱索托财政部门发布三台服务器设备采购公告
items.title_en: Lesotho finance ministry tenders three servers for public debt and treasury departments
items.summary: 非洲开发银行于11月9日发布莱索托债务与支出管理机构支持项目的ICT设备采购公告，分两标段：公共债务部门服务器1台、财政部门服务器2台，合同签署后两个月内交货。具体投标资格及截止日期以官方采购文件为准。
items.summary_en: On 9 November, the African Development Bank published a specific procurement notice for ICT equipment under Lesotho's Institutional Support Project for Debt and Expenditure Management. Lot 1 is one server for the Public Debt Department; Lot 2 is two servers for the Treasury Department, to be delivered within two months of contract signature. Eligibility and deadlines are subject to official tender documents.
items.why_it_matters: 属于真实公开设备采购，但规模较小，适合专业ICT供应商参与。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a verifiable public equipment tender, albeit small in scale and most relevant to qualified ICT suppliers.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注服务器供应、出口代理与本地系统集成合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor server supply, export distribution and local systems integration partners.
